title: Loop host computes a bounded decision sequence
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, and let $I$ be a predicate on pairs of Boolean words, $g$ a state-update function, $A$ a Boolean acceptance test, and $O$ an output-word function. Let $s_0$ assign an initial word to each input, and let $R,T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Assume $F$ computes the word of binary digits of $R(|x|)$ on each input $x$ in time $T(|x|)$; $I(x,s_0(x))$ holds for every $x$ and is preserved by $g$; and for each $x$, the run of $B$ from its initial configuration reaches the seam configuration at state $a$ with tape words assigned by $s_0(x)$ within some time $t\le T(|x|)$, without having state $a$ at any earlier time. Also assume that for every $x,s$ with $I(x,s)$, there is a time $t$ with $0<t\le T(|x|)$ such that the run of $B$ from the seam configuration at $a$ with tape words assigned by $s$ does not have state $a$ at any intermediate time $t'$ with $0<t'<t$; at time $t$, if $A(x,s)$ is true the run is halted with output $O(x,s)$, and otherwise it is the seam configuration at $a$ with tape words assigned by $g(x,s)$. Then for every input $x$ there are a sequence of loop-host configurations $c_i$ and a startup time $u$ such that $u\le 10(T(|x|)+1)$, the loop host's run from its initial configuration at time $u$ is $c_0$, every $c_i$ for $i\le R(|x|)$ has empty output, and $c_{R(|x|)+1}$ is halted with output $[]$ in find mode and $[\mathrm{false}]$ otherwise. Moreover, for every $i\le R(|x|)$ there is a time $t\le 10(T(|x|)+1)$ such that, if $A(x,g^{[i]}(s_0(x)))$ is true, the run from $c_i$ is halted at time $t$ with output $[]$ in find mode and $[\mathrm{true}]$ otherwise; if it is false, that run at time $t$ equals $c_{i+1}$. Here $g^{[i]}$ denotes $i$-fold iteration of $s\mapsto g(x,s)$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite machines $B,F$ and anchor state $a$ of $B$
Predicate $I$, update function $g$, acceptance test $A$, output function $O$
$F$ computes binary digits of $R(|x|)$ within time $T(|x|)$ for every input
For every input, a bounded initial run reaches the specified seam configuration without an earlier visit to $a$
For every invariant state, a positive bounded round run avoids intermediate visits to $a$
Each round run halts with output $O(x,s)$ when accepted
Each nonaccepting round run reaches the seam configuration for $g(x,s)$
